briefdescription.para: Return true if this Loop and all inner subloops are in LCSSA form.

briefdescription.para: Return true if the Loop is in the form that the LoopSimplify form transforms loops to, which is sometimes called normal form.
Return true if the loop body is safe to clone in practice.
Returns true if the loop is annotated parallel.

detaileddescription.para: A parallel loop can be assumed to not contain any dependencies between iterations by the compiler. That is, any loop-carried dependency checking can be skipped completely when parallelizing the loop on the target machine. Thus, if the parallel loop information originates from the programmer, e.g. via the OpenMP parallel for pragma, it is the programmer's responsibility to ensure there are no loop-carried dependencies. The final execution order of the instructions across iterations is not guaranteed, thus, the end result might or might not implement actual concurrent execution of instructions across multiple iterations.

briefdescription.para: Return the llvm.loop loop id metadata node for this loop if it is present.

detaileddescription.para: If this loop contains the same llvm.loop metadata on each branch to the header then the node is returned. If any latch instruction does not contain llvm.loop or if multiple latches contain different nodes then 0 is returned.

briefdescription.para: Set the llvm.loop loop id metadata for this loop.

detaileddescription.para: The LoopID metadata node will be added to each terminator instruction in the loop that branches to the loop header.
The LoopID metadata node should have one or more operands and the first operand should be the node itself.

briefdescription.para: Add llvm.loop.unroll.disable to this loop's loop id metadata.

detaileddescription.para: Remove existing unroll metadata and add unroll disable metadata to indicate the loop has already been unrolled. This prevents a loop from being unrolled more than is directed by a pragma if the loop unrolling pass is run more than once (which it generally is).

briefdescription.para: Add llvm.loop.mustprogress to this loop's loop id metadata.
Return the debug location of the start of this loop.

detaileddescription.para: This looks for a BB terminating instruction with a known debug location by looking at the preheader and header blocks. If it cannot find a terminating instruction with location information, it returns an unknown location.
